name: agent-board
description: A row above the prompt for the subagents Claude starts: running and done per model, a token bar, and a working pixel crew

maxHaiku.title: Haiku limit
maxHaiku.description: How many Haiku subagents may run at once. Set, the row shows running/limit and turns red above it; unset, only the count. Whole numbers from 1 up.

maxSonnet.title: Sonnet limit
maxSonnet.description: How many Sonnet subagents may run at once. Set, the row shows running/limit and turns red above it; unset, only the count. Whole numbers from 1 up.

maxOpus.title: Opus limit
maxOpus.description: How many Opus subagents may run at once. Set, the row shows running/limit and turns red above it; unset, only the count. Whole numbers from 1 up.

hideAfter.title: Hide after (minutes)
hideAfter.description: Minutes after the last subagent ended until the row hides; it comes back with the next one. 0 keeps it shown.

titles.title: Show titles
titles.description: Show the words `agents` (the row's title) and `Split` (the token bar's label), which are hidden by default.

compact.title: Always short labels
compact.description: Always write the families as Ha, So, Op, Ot (and the bar as Sp), not only when the terminal is narrow.

hideUnused.title: Hide unused families
hideUnused.description: Show a family only once it had a subagent in this chat (Other likewise); by default Haiku, Sonnet and Opus always show.
